title: Dealer / Rooftop Partition
description: The layer that tells CDK which Peterbilt Atlantic rooftop and which department (parts, service, accounting...) a piece of data lives in.
x-sap-analogue: Company Code (T001) / Plant (WERKS) plus a module-scoping flag
x-api-note: Subscription-Id and Department-Id are required headers on every Fortellis CDK Drive call, but there is no public REST field named 'Company Number' — that concept is legacy/EDI-layer only.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.

subscription_id.description: Fortellis-issued ID that says which store/app pairing is making this call
subscription_id.x-source-title: CDK Drive Get Customer v3, Fortellis API doc

department_id.description: Says which DMS department (Accounting, Finance, Inventory, Parts, or Service) the request is scoped to; response data is filtered by it
department_id.x-source-title: CDK Drive Get Customer v3, Fortellis API doc

dms_type_accounting_finance_inventory_pa.description: Each Department-Id is permanently bound to exactly one of these five subsystems
dms_type_accounting_finance_inventory_pa.x-source-title: CDK Drive parts API specification (Fortellis PDF)

cmf_client_dealer_id.description: The top-level CDK client ID tied to the dealership's DealerSuite/eStore account — the anchor everything else hangs off

company_number_company_id_co_id.description: Store-level accounting entity inside your CMF; third-party shop tools require a 'Default Company ID (store number)' per store

orgname_apidmsinfo_subscription_report.description: Field in the Fortellis subscription report that lists the store associated with each API for a subscription

authorization_bearer_token.description: OAuth2 bearer token from Fortellis's identity server, required on every call
authorization_bearer_token.x-source-title: CDK Drive Get Customer v3 developer guide
